_comment: Vess's counter hub -- the delivery-loop's entry point, same shape as selys_delivery.json's hub (Take/Turn-in options gated on a code-side bool, deferred effects that swap to a code-built result graph). `delivery_accepted` is a THIRD sanctioned non-accomplishment ctx extension (after `gold` [D1] and `board_accepted` [DP2]) -- WIGame._build_dialogue_ctx exposes it, WIDialogue._meets/_progress_gated already recognize the shape generically (any plain bool key), so no dialogue.gd change was needed.

hub.speaker: Vess
hub.text: Counter's open. Taking a slip, turning one in, or just here to admire the board?

options._comment: Opens the delivery picker (built at runtime from data/deliveries.json's current active slate -- see bounties.gd's build_delivery_picker_graph). Hidden once a slip is already accepted -- v1 simplification, one job at a time, mirroring accept_bounty's own rule (Vess won't log a second slip while one's outstanding).

Resolves a turn-in attempt against whichever delivery is currently accepted (WIGame.turn_in_delivery -- gold + a completed_delivery_<id> accomplishment on a MET condition; the same opaque-safe refusal line either way, no progress numbers). Hidden until a slip is accepted (the mirror gate of 'Take a slip.' above).
